title: Author BM25 Indexing, Incremental and Atomic Re-Index Tests
instructions: Append after the previous chunk without editing earlier lines. Write physical pytest cases (real SQLite FTS5 databases and Markdown files under tmp_path; no mock objects): test_ch06_fr_002_* for SRS-412-06-FR-002 (All knowledge documents shall be indexed in the SQLite FTS5 database (`knowledge_index.db`) using BM25 relevance scoring.); test_ch06_fr_008_* for SRS-412-06-FR-008 (The FTS5 indexer shall support both incremental document updates and atomic full re-indexing.); test_ch06_fts5_index_desynchronization_* for FAILURE:FTS5 Index Desynchronization (If document hash differs from indexed hash, the indexer triggers a non-blocking background re-index of the file.); test_ch06_nfr_rag_02_* for NFR-RAG-02 (FTS5 index size shall not exceed 1.5x the raw Markdown corpus size.)
